market_definition: SportyBet market 225 full-game totals, overtime included
settlement_rules: Market ID 225 and saved Over/Under line/pick required
Existing settlement outcomes are never overwritten
ROI requires a verified immutable publication snapshot, fresh quote and both valid prices

summary.roi_basis: Flat 1-unit stake at the saved selected-side SportyBet decimal price; pushes excluded; only verified publication snapshots count

records.settlement_source: ESPN official scoreboard event ID; final score includes overtime
